subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled localhost FAL provider-path transcript sufficient for this explicit private-network request-policy change, or must the contributor demonstrate a redacted representative FAL proxy/TLS or external private-endpoint route before merge?
rationale: The implementation and focused tests look correct, but only a human owner can calibrate the real external transport proof required for an intentional, operator-opt-in security-boundary expansion.

options.title: Require representative transport proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted run through an actual proxy/TLS route or representative external private endpoint before merging.

options.title: Accept controlled provider-path proof
options.body: Explicitly waive the external-route proof because the localhost run exercises the normal provider path and the shared resolver already owns proxy/TLS behavior.

recommendation.title: Require representative transport proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted run through an actual proxy/TLS route or representative external private endpoint before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision concerns the repository-wide provider request-policy and private-network security contract rather than FAL parsing logic alone.
